question: Top 10 customers by total order count
ground_truth_sql: SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM catalog.schema.orders GROUP BY customer_id ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 10
generated_sql: SELECT customer_id, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS r FROM catalog.schema.orders GROUP BY customer_id
judge_rationale: Generated SQL uses RANK() without LIMIT; returns all customers ranked rather than top 10
expected_repair_hypothesis: Replace RANK() with ROW_NUMBER() and add LIMIT 10
